sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a needle drops and the march's first bar skips three times over the wheezing harmonium, then lurches on}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the tower's march tune on a warped music box and honky-tonk piano, each phrase sticking and repeating its last note, the pitch wobbling as if the tape is stretching}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {again, but the tuba comes in a beat out of step and the piano drifts flat, the record skips twice per phrase and the clock ticks unevenly}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the record slows and speeds like a hand on the turntable, the tune bending down and up in pitch over the wheezing harmonium, then it catches}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the stuck march again, skipping on its last bar over and over until it jolts straight back to the top of the tune}
